audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 was credited to Yone while whys[2] calls it a skill lane, and 2+ items was credited to Yone while whys[6] says your AP scaling, slows and Hemoplague beat his single-target dive.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Vladimir, Skill, Skill, Yone, Vladimir, Yone, Vladimir.
audit.corrected: Row 2 to Skill (5/10), row 6 to Vladimir (7/10), as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: The 3-5 window, his level-6 combo, his first-item all-in window and your two-item teamfight scaling are all placed correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed is described as a 'knock-back' in spikes[1].text and wants.you[1]. Riot's text says he blinks behind the last champion in the line and pulls everyone hit toward him — the displacement goes the other way, which changes where you must stand. Spirit Cleave's shield was never mentioned anywhere, and no line carried a cooldown or range.
audit.why: Kit file: Q Mortal Steel 450 range / 4s, dashes and knocks up at 2 stacks; W Spirit Cleave 700 range / 14s, shields more per champion hit; E Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10s, forces his spirit back to his body; R Fate Sealed 120/100/80s, pulls toward him. Vladimir's Q and E reach 600, Pool is 2s untargetable on 28s.
audit.corrected: The pull described correctly, the Spirit Cleave shield and its 14s written into the don'ts, and Soul Unbound's 22s plus the 600-vs-450 range gap put into the do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The most punishable cooldown was named but never quantified.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and ends by snapping him back to his body — that return is your free poke window.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now carries the number and the timing.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Poke there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and snaps him back — poke him at the return.

edits.before: Transfusion Yone on cooldown, E-charge behind the wave, and pool the one ability his kill plan needs.
edits.after: Transfusion reaches 600 and his Mortal Steel only 450 — poke the step-up and hold that gap.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks means his next Q knocks up — pool it.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Q3 dashes him in with the knock-up — space so the third cast cannot reach.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s — poke through it, don't burst.

edits.before: Hemoplague plus pool sustain tips the fight to you — Yone's Fate Sealed knock-back is scary but you can pool the airborne combo and out-heal his mixed damage.
edits.after: Hemoplague plus pool sustain tips the fight to you — Yone's Fate Sealed blinks behind you and drags you back to him, but you can pool it and out-heal his mixed damage.

edits.before: Save Sanguine Pool for his E-return burst or R knock-back
edits.after: Save Sanguine Pool for his E-return burst or his R pull

notes: Fate Sealed pulls toward Yone, it does not knock back — the page had it backwards in two places, which changes where the reader should stand relative to his line. No mirror existed yet; yone__vladimir should restate rows 2 and 6 inverted.
